Bio: His true identity remains completely unknown. All that is confirmed is that he emerges exclusively on stormy nights of ceaseless rain, tearing through the mountain passes at unfathomable speeds. A living legend who dominated Hakone long ago behind the wheel of classic machinery, he knows the complete lore and history of every touge. In recent times, countless racers have flocked to challenge him after hearing whispers of Ground Zero, but he reveals his genuine driving only to those he personally deems worthy. Having pushed the vintage KPGC10 to its absolute limits, his transcendent ability to leave cutting-edge modern machines in his wake as easily as snapping a twig has rightfully crossed into the realm of the divine.
Relationships: Veteran touge mentor, prologue arbiter, and legendary elder stationed at Hakone. Tests all aspiring mountain drivers before granting pass progression across Japan's touge networks. Maintains deep respect from both local pass aces and touring expressway veterans; serves as the ultimate gatekeeper guarding the sacred asphalt of Hakone.
Rumor: [NEW] You wish to take me on? Do you truly believe you possess the credentials? Are you prepared to prove it right here? / [CONQUEST] ...Hmph, you’ve sharpened your skills. But the true abyss of the touge begins here.

Display Name: イナズマシフトの拓也
Bio: Delivering milk daily to the hotel atop the mountain pass is his routine. Having recently caught the eye of a director from a famous works racing team, he is preparing to embark on a professional racing career. Even so, he cannot shake the persistent feeling that he left something irreplaceable behind on these mountain passes, still slipping away to visit the touge whenever he has free time.
Relationships: Leader of Tokyo expressway team DIAMOND IMAGE; appears as an elite TRICKER across KB1 (#23), KB2 (#24), and KB3 (#16) testing technical touge skills.
Rumor: [NEW] Yeah. I’ve heard plenty of rumors about you. How about it?? Want to have a battle with me?? There are things you can only discover by testing yourself against a strong opponent. / [CONQUEST] Yeah, that’s great. That feeling. I’m genuinely glad to have gained another person to strive toward.

Bio: First crossed paths with Atsuta right here on Hakone Nanamagari when Atsuta was searching for a "street racer piloting an exceptionally rare machine." Ever since, Suzuki and Atsuta have partnered in lockstep to track down that elusive driver, though they have yet to find them. Suzuki normally focuses his battles around the Tokyo Shuto expressway, swinging by Hakone whenever the mood strikes.
Relationships: Hakone Seven Curves challenger (Mail #000) hunting legendary touge machines on behalf of Tokyo expressway racers alongside Atsuta.
Rumor: [NEW] I’ve made quite a name for myself on the Shuto Expressway, and that doesn't change one bit out here on the mountain passes. / [CONQUEST] Incredible. Hey, haven’t you ever thought about coming to run the Shuto Expressway?? I reckon you’d do serious damage out there.

Bio: A frontline member of Kingdom Twelve, an elite syndicate assembled in direct response to the legendary Tokyo Shuto syndicate, the Thirteen Devils. Only drivers capable of performing to the immaculate standards of the Kingdom's name are permitted entry. Furuya takes immense pride in his handling of high-spec machinery, serving as Haruna's gatekeeper.
Relationships: Haruna Downhill front gate enforcer for Hamagaki's Kingdom Twelve in an AE111 Levin, defending the pass from expressway invaders.
Rumor: [NEW] When it comes to piloting an R34, I doubt there are many who can match my skill. I'll demonstrate driving worthy of defending the Kingdom's dignity. / [CONQUEST] Mmmgh!! However, battling you has undoubtedly elevated my own rank as well.

Display Name: 裏切りのジャックナイフ
Bio: Considerable time has elapsed since he carved out an enduring legend behind the wheel of his previous S13 Silvia; today, an FD3S RX-7 serves as his trusted steed. The legendary syndicate that once ruled Tokyo's expressways—the Thirteen Devils—has at last mobilized to conquer the nation's mountain passes. Deployed as the spearhead at Haruna Downhill, Sakamoto tests the waters of mountain competition firsthand.
Relationships: 13 Devils vanguard deployed to Haruna Downhill in an FD3S RX-7. Maintains an intense rivalry with Hamagaki's Kingdom Twelve.
Rumor: [NEW] Just how high is the caliber of these mountain passes? Let Sakamoto here take the vanguard and find out firsthand... / [CONQUEST] The caliber of these passes is genuinely impressive... You're not half bad, are you??

Bio: A core member of the ultimate mountain racing collective, Kingdom Twelve. Tsuruoka's mastery behind high-horsepower rear-drive vehicles is awe-inspiring; he deftly maneuvers a substantial chassis with the agile grace of a lightweight compact, executing clean, effortless high-speed lines. Stationed as the gatekeeper of Akagi Uphill to repel all intruders.
Relationships: Akagi Uphill barrier for Kingdom Twelve in a CP9A Lancer Evolution VI T.M.E., battling the 13 Devils' Bloodhound.
Rumor: [NEW] The THIRTEEN DEVILS are right here at this parking area right now!! I don't care who you are, just stay out of our way while we hunt them down. / [CONQUEST] With such pathetic technique, I have no business trying to purge the THIRTEEN DEVILS... I need to train far harder!!

Bio: One of the cornerstones of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Sasaki is a tireless perfectionist who built his formidable skill through relentless, methodical practice. The airtight, mistake-free driving technique forged from that iron discipline remains fully lethal on the mountain passes. He shares a close friendship with fellow Devil Kiriji Sakamoto, forming an impenetrable tandem across Kanto touge.
Relationships: Methodical perfectionist of the 13 Devils deployed to Akagi Downhill in a BCNR33 GT-R; duels Kingdom Twelve's Akagi vanguard.
Rumor: [NEW] Expressway or mountain touge, a machine is a machine. Driving technique devoid of flaws resides squarely in the realm of the divine. / [CONQUEST] Even gods must fall to earth eventually, it seems... Frankly, your driving gave me chills.

Bio: A core member of the ultimate touge collective, Kingdom Twelve. A 4WD specialist who previously mastered the ultra-rare 22B, he unleashes machines with near-illegal power outputs straight onto downhill sections, engaging in full-throttle, high-output mountain descents. Tasked with halting the Kansai advances of the 13 Devils' Gloomy Angel at Ura-Rokko.
Relationships: Ura-Rokko technical specialist for Kingdom Twelve in a BCNR33 GT-R, standing firm against the 13 Devils' Gloomy Angel.
Rumor: [NEW] I hear some absurd racer calling themselves "Gloomy Angel" has been prowling around here lately... Could that be you?? / [CONQUEST] Your driving is leagues beyond the likes of the Thirteen Devils. I almost want to invite you into the Kingdom myself.

Bio: One of the elite drivers of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Kuroe possesses an enigmatic personality: always wearing a wistful, melancholic expression and exuding an aloof, gloomy aura. Yet once a battle begins, she transforms completely, unleashing raw predatory fighting instinct behind the wheel. Analytical at her core, she deciphers telemetry while driving with ruthless poise.
Relationships: 13 Devils outer loop specialist deployed to Ura-Rokko Downhill in an S15 Silvia. Analyzes telemetry while projecting a detached, melancholy aura.
Rumor: [NEW] Battles... If you're fast you win, and nothing else matters to me. Don't loiter in front of me... / [CONQUEST] Tch... Did you come over just to gloat at the face of a beaten dog?...

Bio: A core member of the ultimate mountain collective, Kingdom Twelve. While he prizes a vintage classic rotary chassis, his fully built machine leaves average, soft-tuned contemporary sports cars entirely in the dust. That blistering pace owes a massive debt to Soma's own innate driving talent and fearless throttle commitment through technical bends.
Relationships: Myogi mountain climber for Kingdom Twelve in an FD3S RX-7, guarding the technical ridges against outside challengers.
Rumor: [NEW] Whoa!! Here they come!! You really showed up!! Email sure is handy, isn't it? Let's get right down to battle!! / [CONQUEST] Man, what a magnificent run. Around these parts, I doubt there's anyone left who could possibly hold a candle to you, is there??

Bio: One of the cornerstones of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. At the time, following their defeat, the Thirteen Devils had temporarily disbanded and scattered; yet even amidst that hiatus, Takenaka never stepped down from the Tokyo expressway, continuing his relentless pursuit of driving perfection. Bringing that same obsessive work ethic to the touge, he reigns as the undisputed fastest on the treacherous Usui Pass. For reasons unknown, he is extraordinarily popular with women.
Relationships: 13 Devils veteran deployed to Usui Pass Downhill in an FC3S RX-7. His bio explicitly documents the Devils' temporary post-2001 disbandment and 2005 touge reunification under Jintei.
Rumor: [NEW] Even with my limited experience on these mountain passes, your blistering speed comes through loud and clear. You are the ultimate prey for the THIRTEEN DEVILS. / [CONQUEST] Hmph... To think such a monstrous racer existed on these mountain passes... Yet your driving bears an uncanny resemblance to the White Charisma.

Bio: Having finally grown comfortable with mountain driving, his technical proficiency has risen substantially. Reflecting on his own abilities, he began to think: even without chasing glory in Tokyo, wouldn't I be able to carve out a real legacy right here? In the absence of team founder Satoru Kobayakawa, he has finally begun to discover his own identity.
Relationships: Younger brother of Satoru Kobayakawa. Assumed leadership of the touge chapter on Omote-Rokko after Satoru departed for Tokyo, resisting moving to Tokyo until later joining ROLLING GUY in SBX.
Rumor: [NEW] Maybe I should forget about moving to Tokyo and just keep my racing firmly rooted right here on local soil?? / [CONQUEST] I really can't stop agonizing over whether to move to Tokyo or not...

Bio: Takes immense pride in a suspension setup dialed in to absolute perfection for the touge. Though engine modifications remain modest, the chassis grip far exceeds the power output, resulting in remarkable overall vehicle balance. After a tuner pointed out that balance, he completely abandoned thoughts of a turbo conversion.
Relationships: Loyal right-hand man to Tetsu Kobayakawa in the Omote-Rokko AE86 squad; later joins C1 ROLLING GUY in SB01.
Rumor: [NEW] How do you like this 86!! Take a real close look at this suspension setup. It's dialed in to perfection, isn't it?! / [CONQUEST] The footwork was spot on, but I got beat on raw engine horsepower this time... Time to pursue even higher engine tuning.

Bio: Lives by the code of flashy, high-spectacle drifting, spending day and night executing aggressive slides around gymkhana training pads. Possessing a fiery temper, he was privately the most infuriated when original leader Satoru Kobayakawa packed up for Tokyo, though he rarely allows that bitterness to show openly.
Relationships: Omote-Rokko AE86 regular; honed his drift style on Kansai touge before taking his machine to C1 in SB01.
Rumor: [NEW] I'll show you that the spectacle drift honed in gymkhana translates directly into sheer speed! / [CONQUEST] I've been spending way too much time on gymkhana pads... Mountain passes demand a specialized approach tailored strictly to the touge...

Bio: Possessing standout technical proficiency, Takayanagi stepped up smoothly as the technical backbone of the newly reorganized Downhill Guy after founding leader Satoru Kobayakawa departed, with zero objection from any teammate. He no longer has the luxury of making excuses about lacking funds to tune his machine.
Relationships: Omote-Rokko AE86 technician focusing on vehicle telemetry and suspension setup; regular across both touge and C1.
Rumor: [NEW] Now that Kobayakawa is gone, if I can't showcase our real strength in front of everyone, this team is finished!! / [CONQUEST] The power to lead and unite a team... I believe I've learned that firsthand from your driving.

Bio: A core member of the ultimate touge collective, Kingdom Twelve. An uncompromising purist who firmly believes that dominating the mountain passes behind the wheel of a front-wheel-drive machine is what makes a true mountain king. His ferocious FF driving down Omote-Rokko holds its own against even high-powered 4WD and FR rivals.
Relationships: Front-wheel-drive vanguard for Kingdom Twelve deployed to Omote-Rokko Downhill in a DC5 Integra Type R to counter the 13 Devils' Dying Star.
Rumor: [NEW] Dominating the passes in a front-wheel-drive machine is what makes a real man! Taste the weight of this crushing hammer! / [CONQUEST] Ugh... To think your line would be so much cleaner than my FF. Looks like this hammer smashed my own foot instead of yours.

Bio: One of the cornerstones of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Holding immense prestige within the syndicate, Uozumi extracts the mechanical grip of four-wheel-drive to an almost supernatural degree. Deploying his tuned CT9A Lancer Evolution to Omote-Rokko Downhill, he treats the mountain passes as fertile new hunting grounds to restore the Devils' absolute dominance.
Relationships: 13 Devils 4WD anchor deployed to Omote-Rokko Downhill in a CT9A Lancer Evolution, clashing directly with Kingdom Twelve's Hammer of the Pike.
Rumor: [NEW] Once you step foot onto these passes, don't expect to leave unscathed. Show me how long you can endure beneath the light of this Dying Star! / [CONQUEST] Breathless speed... It seems the world of the mountain passes is truly as bottomless as the sea.

Bio: A core member of the ultimate mountain collective, Kingdom Twelve. Renowned for commanding a Subaru Impreza GDB, he is a master of engine management and chassis calibration under the thin air and unforgiving weather of alpine altitudes. Stationed at Shiga Kusatsu, he duels the 13 Devils' Midnight Rose in a high-altitude rally clash.
Relationships: High-altitude stronghold anchor for Kingdom Twelve at Shiga Kusatsu in a GDB Impreza WRX STI, engaging the 13 Devils' Midnight Rose.
Rumor: [NEW] Atop these treacherous peaks where even breathing is a battle, only my Chariot reigns supreme! / [CONQUEST] Damn it... To maintain such a flawless rhythm in this thin mountain air... I severely underestimated you.

Bio: One of the elite members of the Thirteen Devils (formerly of The Zodiac). Known across Tokyo's expressways as a vibrant, poisonous thorn blooming at midnight, she transitioned to a new high-displacement Z33 Fairlady to conquer the breathtaking yet perilous crags of Shiga Kusatsu. Her lines are gorgeous yet razor-sharp, shredding challengers like rose thorns.
Relationships: 13 Devils and former Zodiac ace deployed to Shiga Kusatsu in a Z33 Fairlady, facing off against Kingdom Twelve's King Chariot.
Rumor: [NEW] Very few drivers in all of Japan can keep up with the scent of this Midnight Rose. Are you prepared to get cut by my thorns? / [CONQUEST] Truly mesmerizing strength... Just for today, this rose willingly bows her head to you.

Bio: Vanguard commander of the True Shuto 1st Division. Puffed up with imperial arrogance and iron-fisted tactics, he fancies himself the Napoleon of the mountain passes. Descending upon Nikko Irohazaka in a Subaru Legacy BL5, he vows to crush both regional locals and the Thirteen Devils under his marching boots.
Relationships: True Shuto 1st Division vanguard deployed to Nikko in a Legacy B4 BL5, probing defenses with aggressive reconnaissance.
Rumor: [NEW] The word 'defeat' does not exist in my dictionary! Witness the grand imperial march of a conqueror! / [CONQUEST] Impossible... Could Napoleon's Waterloo truly happen on a narrow mountain switchback like this?!

Bio: A core member of True Shuto 1st Division. Having pulled himself back from the brink of despair following chronic chest illness, he took the wheel of a Legacy Touring Wagon BP5 to tackle Nikko. Though still barred from intense physical exertion, he focuses pure concentration into delicate throttle and steering modulations.
Relationships: True Shuto division technician deployed on mountain reconnaissance in KB2 (#165) and KB3 (#212) piloting a Legacy Touring Wagon BP5.
Rumor: [NEW] Having sworn never to throw in the towel again, I'm not going down easily. Come on, let me see what you've got! / [CONQUEST] What an exhilarating match... It seems taking those extra four minutes to choose life was the best decision I ever made.

Bio: A driver in True Shuto 1st Division. Still unable to shake the bizarre trauma of being confessed to by a hulking woman who mistook him for her high school crush, he upgraded to a heavyweight twin-turbo Mitsubishi GTO for the Nikko campaign. The heavy-hitting 4WD traction grants him the courage to face fearsome foes.
Relationships: Shuto division member running modified Silvia and GTO in KB2 (#164) and KB3 (#213), reinforcing the Nikko front.
Rumor: [NEW] Honestly, thinking you can beat me is about twelve years premature! / [CONQUEST] Well, that's that. Don't rub it in that I lost; I'm painfully aware of it already.

Bio: Scout for the True Shuto 2nd Division. On the surface, he projects a calm, harmless expression, but don't be fooled for a second: his true nature is deceitful, with a passion for espionage and sabotage. Behind the wheel of his Bluebird SSS-R, he compiles reconnaissance data on every pass in Japan.
Relationships: Shuto 2nd Division scout running a Bluebird SSS-R in KB2 (#163) and KB3 (#217), surveying rival telemetry.
Rumor: [NEW] I've been slacking off on drifting lately and feel completely lethargic, but I guess I'll muster up some effort for you. / [CONQUEST] Coming out here today was a huge mistake. I'm just going to head home and sleep it off...

Bio: Reinforcement for True Shuto 2nd Division. Attacks mountain passes behind the wheel of a hand-me-down Subaru Impreza GC8 inherited from his older brother. Approaching everything with an aloof, detached demeanor, he never gets overly passionate in battle. Having recently splurged on an expensive LCD television, he has zero funds left for car tuning.
Relationships: Shuto 2nd Division reinforcement in KB3 (#218), campaigning a classic GF-GC8 Impreza wagon.
Rumor: [NEW] Such a hassle!! Seriously, what a pain!! I just want to laze around at home... / [CONQUEST] Honestly, I would have had a much better time dozing off under warm blankets while watching TV.

Bio: Spearhead for True Shuto 2nd Division. A hopeless consumerist demon whose passion is hoarding gadgets, home appliances, and high-tech gear. His insatiable consumerism knows no bounds: home theater projectors, AV surround sound, cutting-edge mobile laptops, and the latest phones. Naturally, the cockpit of his GTO is overflowing with GPS screens, high-end audio, and digital tech.
Relationships: Persistent spearhead of Shuto infiltration raids across KB1 (#147), KB2 (#166), and KB3 (#219), testing mountain drivers against Tokyo expressway veterans.
Rumor: [NEW] A truly fast racer has arrived!! Let me show you the full, upgraded might of the evolved Great Material Death Metal!! / [CONQUEST] Thanks to losing to you, my shopping impulses just kicked into full twin-turbo boost!! What on earth am I supposed to do now?...

Bio: A core warrior of the ultimate mountain collective, Kingdom Twelve. Piloting a cutting-edge Lancer Evolution VIII MR, Date effortlessly overcomes early tuning disadvantages through sheer natural talent. Stationed at the critical chokepoints of Nikko under strict orders from Hamagaki to ruthlessly eliminate the Thirteen Devils and encroaching challengers.
Relationships: Irohazaka pass commander for Kingdom Twelve in a CT9A Lancer Evolution VIII MR, executing Hamagaki's purge orders against the 13 Devils.
Rumor: [NEW] Don't take it personally; these are direct marching orders from the leader of KINGDOM TWELVE. My mission is to take you down. / [CONQUEST] Why the leader is so obsessively hellbent on purging you from these mountain passes completely baffles me...

Display Name: 追撃のテイルガンナー
Bio: One of the cornerstones of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Operates under the iron creed of precise situational assessment and rock-solid, mistake-free lines. His machine has evolved substantially beyond his Shuto expressway days; with flawless braking response, razor cornering, and savage acceleration, his package is exceptionally refined. Stationed on Nikko's hairpins to systematically hunt down Kingdom Twelve.
Relationships: 13 Devils Wangan chaser deployed to the treacherous switchbacks of Irohazaka Downhill in a BNR34 GT-R, clashing with Kingdom Twelve's Eradication Cavalry.
Rumor: [NEW] My tuning and setup have reached the realm of absolute completion lately... I will take you down in peak condition. / [CONQUEST] Against such an immaculate machine, what fell short was the driver behind the wheel... Nothing left to do but train harder.

Bio: A core member of the ultimate mountain collective, Kingdom Twelve. Shares a fierce, productive rivalry with fellow 4WD ace Motonari Date, constantly trading setup insights. Currently, Tsurugi holds a slim lead in head-to-head victory counts. Stationed at the technical labyrinth of Happogahara to halt the advance of the 13 Devils' Shadow Eyes.
Relationships: Happogahara stronghold anchor for Kingdom Twelve in a BNR32 GT-R, barring the path against the 13 Devils' Shadow Eyes.
Rumor: [NEW] The ultimate spec for these mountain passes is 4WD. Anyone tripping up at the car selection stage lacks the basic aptitude of a street racer. / [CONQUEST] Armed with complete 4WD mastery, if there's still something lacking in me... What on earth could it be!?

Bio: One of the elite drivers of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Shares a close romantic connection with fellow Devil Kenji Naito (Pursuit Tail Gunner). Dissatisfied with ruling the Tokyo expressway alone, she expanded her ambitions to conquering mountain touge. Her primary technical objective is mastering both expressway sweeps and technical passes behind the wheel of the very same high-power Supra.
Relationships: 13 Devils Yokohane veteran deployed to Happogahara Downhill in a JZA80 Supra, locking horns with Kingdom Twelve's Undefeated Emblem.
Rumor: [NEW] I'd say I accomplished about eighty percent of my goals on the Shuto Expressway. Now by conquering these passes, the THIRTEEN DEVILS will establish complete dominion! / [CONQUEST] To think such a monstrous driver existed on these passes... Seems my eyes were completely blind until now.

Bio: The solitary king reigning as Mount Zao's sovereign 'Absolute Emperor.' Having upgraded to a high-grip 4WD Lancer Evolution, he pushed his already unrivaled cornering mastery to terrifying new heights across frozen mountain passes. Carving through blizzards and black ice with supernatural traction, he awaits those daring enough to challenge the frozen summits.
Relationships: Leader of Mount Zao's ruling syndicate Absolute Emperor, piloting a CT9A Lancer Evolution guarding the alpine peaks.
Rumor: [NEW] Every fool who trespasses onto these frozen summits gets torn to shreds by Zao's blizzards! / [CONQUEST] To defeat me on my absolute home turf... The new sovereign of Zao belongs to you!

Bio: A core member of the ultimate touge collective, Kingdom Twelve. Stationed atop the high ridges of Mount Zao behind the wheel of a classic twin-turbo Toyota Supra JZA70, he engages the 13 Devils' Grief Pluto in an apocalyptic clash of raw straight-six horsepower, erecting an unyielding iron barrier for the Kingdom.
Relationships: High-altitude heavy artillery for Kingdom Twelve deployed to Mount Zao in a JZA70 Supra, intercepting the 13 Devils' Grief Pluto.
Rumor: [NEW] The will of the Kingdom stands rock-solid right here; you won't take a single step past Zao! / [CONQUEST] Even the monstrous power of my JZA70 couldn't hold you back... You've torn a gaping breach straight through our defenses!

Bio: One of the cornerstones of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Revered across Tokyo's Wangan for a tragic, ominous aura of high-speed melancholy, he brought his twin-turbo Nissan Fairlady 300ZX (CZ32) to storm the snowy heights of Mount Zao. His exhaust howl echoes like a mournful cry from the underworld, crushing all obstacles along the frozen ridges.
Relationships: 13 Devils Wangan veteran deployed to Mount Zao Downhill in a CZ32 Fairlady 300ZX, locking horns with Kingdom Twelve's Lionel.
Rumor: [NEW] Atop these frozen heights of the netherworld, listen closely to Pluto's mournful sorrow! / [CONQUEST] To think even Pluto's turbocharged roar could not suppress your brilliance... The abyss of the touge is truly bottomless.

Display Name: ティンバースラッシュ
Bio: A core member of Kingdom Twelve. Combining striking beauty with breathtaking driving skill, she pilots a Nissan Silvia S14 on the slopes of Mount Aso. Having felt unfulfilled across countless prior battles, she aligned with Hamagaki's syndicate to seek her true limits, dueling the 13 Devils' Dreaming Wraith in a volcanic clash.
Relationships: Mount Aso anchor for Kingdom Twelve in an S14 Silvia, defending the volcanic pass against the 13 Devils' Dreaming Wraith.
Rumor: [NEW] If I race against you, perhaps the lingering fog clouding my heart will finally dissipate... Let's go! / [CONQUEST] What an exhilarating match! In you, I truly felt the pure, breathtaking romance of the touge's outer limits.

Bio: One of the elite drivers of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Revered on Tokyo's Shinkanjō for an ethereal, phantom-like driving line that bewildered opponents, he deployed his high-powered Toyota Chaser JZX100 to the volcanic slopes of Mount Aso, blurring the line between illusion and reality through savage high-angle slides.
Relationships: 13 Devils Shinkanjō specialist deployed to Mount Aso Downhill in a JZX100 Chaser, dueling Kingdom Twelve's Timber Slash.
Rumor: [NEW] Amidst this sulfurous volcanic haze, allow yourself to wander lost forever inside my waking phantom dream! / [CONQUEST] To break free from my ghostly apparitions and force an overtake... Your iron will is truly remarkable!

Bio: Supreme commander and founder of Kingdom Twelve. Following his humiliating dethronement at Mount Aso, Hamagaki was consumed by revanchist obsession, founding Kingdom Twelve to systematically crush aspiring touge aces, seize total dominion over Japan's mountain passes, and build the ultimate all-surface rally syndicate. Awaits on the snowy summit of Hokkaido in a modified Z33 for a fateful clash against Jintei and all contenders.
Relationships: Founder and supreme commander of Kingdom Twelve. Assembled a 12-pass revanchist network to crush both regional touge aces and the Thirteen Devils' Shuto invasion; awaits on the snow of Hokkaido in a modified Z33.
Rumor: [NEW] To anyone seeking to disrupt the formation of my supreme, ultimate rally team: as long as I stand here, your reign will never come to pass!! / [CONQUEST] Wahahaha! You're undeniably fast. But mark my words, the world is crawling with drivers of this caliber! Don't let winning against me go straight to your head!!

Bio: Supreme leader of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. That very man hailed as the ultimate living legend of the Shuto Expressway has returned in full glory, mobilizing the expressway's mightiest syndicate across thirteen mountain passes. Piloting a rally-bred Subaru Impreza WRX STI (GDB) on the frozen downhill summit of Hokkaido, he tests whether your speed possesses the credentials to succeed the crown.
Relationships: Supreme sovereign of the Thirteen Devils. Following their temporary hiatus after Shutoko Battle ZERO (2001), reunited the syndicate in 2005 to launch a coordinated nationwide 13-pass touge invasion. Defeated Hamagaki's revanchist Kingdom Twelve syndicate; awaits on the final snowy summit of Hokkaido before returning to Tokyo to form the New Thirteen Devils (Shutoko Battle PSP).
Rumor: [NEW] For some inexplicable reason, I feel that our vectors of driving share the very same essence. I will stop you right here!! / [CONQUEST] To defeat Jintei, the living legend of the Shuto Expressway, with such decisive ease... At this level, even the Kaido President won't stand a chance against you...

Bio: The solitary king once hailed as the absolute fastest on Mount Aso and across all of Japan's mountain touge. Realizing his ultimate rival was not the drivers surrounding him but his own self, he previously vanished completely from nocturnal battles. Unmoved by rising factions, he polishes only his inner craft, delivering racing that is truly, undeniably EMOTIONAL.
Relationships: Reigning touge monarch stationed at the snowy heights of Hokkaido; defends his Emotional King crown against Hamagaki's Kingdom Twelve and Jintei's Thirteen Devils.
Rumor: [NEW] That lone racer who appeared out of nowhere long ago... I sense that very same aura in you. Tonight has me more thrilled than ever before. Entertain me to your heart's content!! / [CONQUEST] Fufufu. A truly wonderful era has arrived. To have a racer like you grace these mountain passes is an honor for every single one of us!!

Bio: A completely cold-blooded individual whose ruthless nature draws constant outrage from those around him: 'Is there even human blood flowing through this guy's veins?!' The technique born from that freezing demeanor is merciless. Driving as if absolutely any method is justified so long as he claims victory, he chills the atmosphere around him to freezing point.
Relationships: Touring Shuto Wanderer (SB0 Iceman); challenges Kirigamine in KB3 (#331) in a Subaru Impreza Wagon GGA.
Rumor: [NEW] Claptrap about being 'heartless' is just loser talk. History is written by the victors. / [CONQUEST] Damn it!! To have my immaculate driving bypassed so casually... What a catastrophic miscalculation!!

Bio: One of the cornerstones of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Deftly maneuvers a mid-engine Toyota MR2 (SW20) across the narrow, technical switchbacks of Kirigamine. The heart of his machine has been tuned and balanced to the bleeding edge, leaving virtually no room for further enhancement. He leaves opponents bewildered in the dark before they even realize what passed them.
Relationships: 13 Devils mid-engine maestro deployed to Kirigamine Uphill in an SW20 MR2, crushing challengers with surgical agility.
Rumor: [NEW] An acceleration that tears the darkness to shreds. By the time you even register it, I will have completely vanished from your sight. / [CONQUEST] Your acceleration is something serious. Especially that explosive snap on corner exit... It actually made my head spin...

Bio: A core member of the ultimate mountain collective, Kingdom Twelve. Commands the treacherous, snow-walled corridor of Yuki no Otani. Leveraging his mid-engine NA2 NSX setup, he carves breathtaking, high-speed lines inches away from monolithic sheer walls of solid packed snow, leaving spectators paralyzed with awe.
Relationships: Snow corridor gatekeeper for Kingdom Twelve at Mount Otani in an NA2 NSX, defending the narrow ice gorge.
Rumor: [NEW] Against these towering frozen snow walls, you won't be able to resist the thrust of this Forbidden Halberd! Hold onto your seat! / [CONQUEST] Ugh... To think even inside Yuki no Otani I couldn't stop you... Whose legendary lineage did you inherit that terrifying technique from??

Bio: One of the cornerstones of Tokyo's legendary Thirteen Devils. Stationed at Otarumi Downhill, he extracts every ounce of screaming VTEC high-RPM power from an AP1 Honda S2000. Renowned for selecting specialized machinery tailored strictly to the characteristics of each battlefield, he later re-emerges in Shutoko Battle X as the famed 'Ryoma of Shinkanjō.'
Relationships: 13 Devils Shinkanjō enforcer deployed to Otarumi Downhill in an AP1 S2000; later re-emerges in SBX as 'Ryoma of Shinkanjō'.
Rumor: [NEW] Switching machines to perfectly coordinate with each distinct stage like tailoring a fine suit is second nature to me! / [CONQUEST] To think such a monstrous driver was hiding on such a local, out-of-the-way pass... Does Jintei already know about you, I wonder...??

Notes: All Passes / Gymkhana | Pinnacle Touge Master & 20 Masters Arbiter
Bio: The solitary master reigning at the apex of the gymkhana world and All-Japan touge trials. The symbolic pillar uniting the elite 20 drivers of "TWENTY MASTER."
